tools.detail: Adobe Photoshop is a professional photo editing software that leverages advanced AI features to enhance the editing process. It offers a wide range of tools and effects to manipulate and enhance images, making it a go-to choice for professional photographers, graphic designers, and digital artists. Key features include AI-driven object removal, content-aware fill, and advanced retouching tools. Photoshop is known for its powerful capabilities, allowing users to perform complex edits with precision. It is designed for users who require a high level of control and flexibility in their image editing. Pros include a vast array of features, seamless integration with other Adobe products, and a strong community support. Limitations include a steep learning curve and a relatively high price point.
